targets.quote: The object of this Directive is to introduce measures to encourage improvements in the safety and health of workers at work.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Member States shall take the necessary steps to ensure that employers, workers and workers' representatives are subject to the legal provisions necessary for the implementation of this Directive.
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: The employer shall have a duty to ensure the safety and health of workers in every aspect related to the work.
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: the employer shall take the measures necessary for the safety and health protection of workers, including prevention of occupational risks and provision of information and training, as well as provision of the necessary organization and means.
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: The employer shall implement the measures referred to in the first subparagraph of paragraph 1 on the basis of the following general principles of prevention:
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: evaluate the risks to the safety and health of workers, inter alia in the choice of work equipment, the chemical substances or preparations used, and the fitting-out of work places.
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: designate one or more workers to carry out activities related to the protection and prevention of occupational risks for the undertaking and/or establishment.
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: as soon as possible, inform all workers who are, or may be, exposed to serious and imminent danger of the risk involved and of the steps taken or to be taken as regards protection;
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: be in possession of an assessment of the risks to safety and health at work, including those facing groups of workers exposed to particular risks;
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: workers and/or their representatives in the undertaking and/or establishment receive, in accordance with national laws and/or practices which may take account, inter alia, of the size of the undertaking and/or establishment, all the necessary information concerning:
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: Employers shall consult workers and/or their representatives and allow them to take part in discussions on all questions relating to safety and health at work.
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: The employer shall ensure that each worker receives adequate safety and health training, in particular in the form of information and instructions specific to his workstation or job:
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: measures shall be introduced in accordance with national law and/or practices.
targets.label: obligation

targets.quote: Particularly sensitive risk groups must be protected against the dangers which specifically affect them.
targets.label: obligation
